external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A person who uses the loyalty programme, mobile app, and partner apps.

external_entities.name: Partner app
external_entities.description: A web application run by another company that can access member rewards data.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in and call the rewards API.
processes.notes: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone. Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

processes.name: Authorization server
processes.description: The authorization server that authenticates members and issues authorization codes, refresh tokens, and access tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
processes.notes: The member's sign-in is kept in a cookie for thirty days. Nobody decided an idle timeout for it.

processes.name: Rewards API
processes.description: The API that reads and writes the points ledger and processes rewards operations.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: It does not check which client or which audience a token was issued for.

processes.name: Support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

processes.name: Browser
processes.description: The browser used by a member to sign in and approve a partner app consent request.
processes.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_stores.name: Identity database
data_stores.description: The database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: Points ledger
data_stores.description: The ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction
data_stores.notes: The ledger records which client made each change, and not which member approved it.

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: The store containing every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs a member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: The browser submits a member's sign-in to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser
data_flows.data_description: Member sign-in credentials and consent interaction

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: The partner app sends token requests to the authorization server using its client credentials.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.authentication: client ID and client secret in request body
data_flows.data_description: Token requests and partner client credentials

data_flows.name: redirect
data_flows.description: The browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: The partner app calls the rewards API to show a member's points.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: The support console obtains access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: download key
data_flows.description: The rewards API downloads the public key used to check access-token signatures when it starts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API checks the signature with a public key it downloads when it starts.

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores and retrieves member identity and authorization data in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_flows.data_description: Member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: update ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write requests
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes received requests and headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.
data_flows.data_description: Requests received by the rewards API and their headers

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud account where the platform components and stores run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: The members' phone environment outside the platform's cloud account.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: apart from the members' phones and the partner apps

trust_boundaries.name: partner apps' own servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is reachable from the internet because it is served on the same public hostname as the support console.
assumptions.basis: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is reachable from the internet because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it holds member email addresses, password hashes, authorization tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The database holds member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it holds member balances and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: The ledger holds every member's balance and every points transaction.
